data.description: The Chest Press Cum Shoulder Press combines two pressing machines on one frame, each with its own orange seat. On the chest press, the user pushes the handles forward from chest height. On the shoulder press, the handles are pushed upward from shoulder height. Both use the user's own body weight as resistance, so there are no weights to load. Putting the two on one frame saves space in a society or corporate gym and lets two people train the upper body together. The finish is Play Orange, matching the rest of our Fun Fitness range. Request the drawing and warranty terms from us when you ask for a price. Our standard warranty covers galvanised pipes for 3 years and bearings for 1 year. Ask us for a quote.

items.pText: The Chest Press Cum Shoulder Press combines two pressing machines on one frame, each with its own orange seat. On the chest press, the user pushes the handles forward from chest height. On the shoulder press, the handles are pushed upward from shoulder height. Both use the user's own body weight as resistance, so there are no weights to load. Putting the two on one frame saves space in a society or corporate gym and lets two people train the upper body together. The finish is Play Orange, matching the rest of our Fun Fitness range. Request the drawing and warranty terms from us when you ask for a price. Our standard warranty covers galvanised pipes for 3 years and bearings for 1 year. Ask us for a quote.

Each station has pivot points that carry the user's weight, so the bearings and seat bolts should be checked on a regular schedule. This combination frame goes in self-standing or grouted. Leave space in front of the chest press handles and above the shoulder press arms so nobody walks into the moving parts.
